verdict.rationale: Kong AI Gateway documents load balancing across multiple LLM models (covering availability-based routing) and per-request cost calculation, which together imply some policy-driven model selection, but there is no explicit documentation of switching models based on capability or triggering mid-task, dynamic policy switches tied to cost or availability thresholds. Missing for 10: explicit cost/capability-based routing policy documentation, mid-task dynamic model switching evidence, and independent/hands-on corroboration of this routing-resilience behavior.
